about_the_game:
«Adeline's Story» — a visual novel in the psychological-horror genre.

After moving from a noisy city to a remote village, Adeline and her friends are drawn into a series of sinister events. People begin to vanish. At night, whispers and voices drift from the forest, and Adeline begins to have strange dreams. Elders speak of a curse, of entities returning from the darkness. To learn why people disappear here, they must comb through abandoned huts and catacombs, decipher ancient books, perform forbidden rituals, summoning spirits and demons — only then can they gather evidence, uncover the forest’s secret, and decide what matters more: surviving at any cost or preserving their humanity.

✔ An atmospheric, non-linear story with elements of mysticism and folklore
✔ A rich mythological foundation: Slavic and Turkic legends, folk beliefs, and bestiaries from various cultures seamlessly woven into the narrative
✔ A tense, oppressive atmosphere
✔ Rituals, spirits, and ancient forces
✔ Haunting music and visuals
✔ Your choices shape the outcome — who is fated to disappear, and who will survive

Some doors are better left unopened… but you will have to open them.

Warning: This game contains scenes of physical and psychological violence, as well as strong language. Proceed with caution and take care of your emotional well-being.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature content, including psychological horror elements, jump scares, depictions of animal corpses, and scenes with blood.
